about: Membership of the blocs that feed bloc states (model/bloc_qids.json), reviewed against each organisation's official member list on 2026-10-20. Wikidata's 'member of' (P463) carries no status: observers and suspended members appear as members (Mexico and Venezuela in Mercosur, the suspended states in the African Union) and several blocs are incomplete or empty (USMCA lists only Mexico, CPTPP, RCEP and the EAEU have no members, the GCC has 3 of 6, CELAC 5 of 33, ASEAN wrongly includes Australia). For the blocs listed in 'members' this list replaces Wikidata; 'status' then removes suspended, observer, departed and non-party states for every bloc. Re-review when membership changes. Added 2026-10-21: nine regional blocs (ECOWAS, SADC, EAC, CARICOM, CAN, Pacific Alliance, AES, SAARC, PIF) with lists taken from each organisation's member list from memory of the public sources; member-specific accession dates are not modelled for them (one entry date per bloc). To be re-checked against the official lists.

MERCOSUR.source: Treaty of Asuncion members; Bolivia full member since 8 July 2024

CELAC.source: CELAC: the 33 Latin American and Caribbean states (Brazil returned in 2023)

USMCA.source: USMCA / T-MEC parties (free trade since NAFTA, 1 Jan 1994; USMCA since 1 Jul 2020)

CPTPP.source: CPTPP parties for which it is in force (United Kingdom since 15 Dec 2024)

RCEP.source: RCEP parties (in force for all 15 by June 2023; Myanmar's status is contested)

ASEAN.source: ASEAN members; Timor-Leste admitted 26 Oct 2025; Australia is a dialogue partner, not a member

SCO.source: SCO members; Iran since 4 Jul 2023, Belarus since 4 Jul 2024

ECOWAS.source: ECOWAS member states after Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger left on 29 Jan 2025; trade liberalisation scheme and free movement, common external tariff only partly applied

SADC.source: SADC Free Trade Area participants (13); Angola, DR Congo and Comoros are SADC members not yet in the free-trade area

EAC.source: East African Community customs union (in force 1 Jan 2005); Burundi and Rwanda joined it in 2009, South Sudan 2016, DR Congo 2022, Somalia 2024

CARICOM.source: CARICOM Single Market and Economy participants (12); Haiti is provisional and the Bahamas is not in the single market

CAN.source: Andean Community: four members (Venezuela left in 2006, Chile in 1976); free-trade zone since 1993

AES.source: Alliance of Sahel States: Liptako-Gourma Charter (mutual defence, 16 Sep 2023), confederation since 6 Jul 2024

PIF.source: Pacific Islands Forum members that are states in the registry (the Cook Islands, Niue and the French territories are not)

status.source: Suspended in December 2016, indefinitely since August 2017
Mexico is an observer, not a member
Suspended after the October 2025 military takeover
Eritrea is the only African Union state that has not signed the AfCFTA

AFCFTA.source: The AfCFTA is in force but its tariff schedules apply only to a limited 'guided trade' set; it is not yet a working free-trade area
